limits: Reading notes are not a proof of every theorem in the thesis.
The 1997 archive capture authenticates these preserved bytes, not NIST use.
A heuristic precomputation stop is not a demonstrated erroneous table or curve rejection.
Original caller, file deployment and candidate visitation remain unknown.

observations.fact: Curve interface evaluates the integer modular polynomial at J=j(E), reduces modulo p, and uses splitting types; no input cube-root-of-j operation is specified.
Type1 eta-quotient construction and Weber formula compute formal q-series and integer coefficient tables; the cube in j=(f2^24+16)^3/f2^24 is a forward formula in precomputation.
Type2 Hecke-index conditions depend on auxiliary l and chosen index n, not curve input p,j or CM conductor.
Integer table construction combines coefficients modulo small primes by CRT and heuristically stops after two unchanged iterations; validation is by counting on test inputs.
Tables are stored as out... ASCII files; atobin uses libI long-integer structures for .bin conversion, bintoa converts back. The thesis reports one equivalent polynomial for every prime l<800.

Named routines include lmod_equ, examine_l, lcompute_eta_de/sp, lcompute_f, lcompute_j, lcompute_A, lcompute_ark and lcompute_ars. The original bodies and output coefficient files were not recovered here.
